default_retention: Collect the minimum, keep raw student evidence for 7 days on Free, 30 days on Pro, and 90 days on Premium only after explicit consent; teachers may choose a shorter period or immediate deletion.
global_rules: Student evidence is untrusted data, never instructions.
No secret is placed in a prompt, log, analytic event, generated document, support reference, or backup manifest.
No teacher account identifier or student evidence is used for provider training where an opt-out or no-training mode is available.
A provider receives only the minimum fields required for the teacher-requested operation.
A failed ownership, consent, retention, or safety check fails closed before provider transmission.

classes.definition: Published help, pricing, feature descriptions, public templates, and non-user-specific configuration intended for anyone.
classes.collection: Version-controlled product authoring or public configuration.
classes.storage: Repository, deployment bundle, or public site.
classes.default_retention: While current plus normal source history.
classes.deletion: Remove from active surfaces when obsolete; source history follows repository policy.
classes.logging: Allowed when no user data is concatenated.
classes.provider: May be sent when necessary; do not combine with a private user payload unless required.
classes.encryption: Transport integrity; repository and deployment controls.

classes.definition: Information identifying, authenticating, billing, supporting, or configuring a teacher account.
classes.collection: Only fields required for account operation, billing, security, or teacher-requested support.
classes.storage: Application database; payment credentials stay with the payment provider.
classes.default_retention: Account lifetime; failed payment attempts 13 months; legally required billing records for the applicable statutory period.
classes.deletion: Revoke access immediately; purge or irreversibly anonymize product identity within 30 days; retain only legally required billing/audit fields.
classes.logging: Never log Telegram IDs, names, handles, callback tokens, payment URLs, support free text, or full provider responses.
classes.backup: Encrypted, access-controlled backups; deletion propagates at restore or natural expiry within 30 days.
classes.provider: Telegram receives messaging identifiers; payment provider receives minimum order fields; LLM provider receives no teacher account identifier.
classes.access: Teacher for own account; least-privilege billing/support operators for their function.
classes.encryption: TLS in transit; encrypted host/storage and hashed callback tokens at rest.

classes.definition: Teacher-owned, non-secret context describing a recurring class and its teaching continuity.
classes.collection: Teacher enters or explicitly approves each field; student names are prohibited.
classes.storage: Teacher-owned application records with revision and class ownership.
classes.default_retention: Account lifetime or until class deletion; inactive-class review after 12 months.
classes.deletion: Class cascade hides immediately; raw evidence purges immediately and metadata purges within 7 days.
classes.logging: IDs and bounded enums only; never class labels, goals, notes, prompt text, or generated material text.
classes.backup: Encrypted with ownership metadata; deletion tombstone reapplied after restore; 30-day maximum backup expiry.
classes.provider: Only teacher-approved fields needed for the requested generation; replace private class label with a random class reference.
classes.access: Owning teacher and narrowly authorized operations; every lookup enforces ownership.
classes.encryption: TLS in transit; encrypted storage and backups.

classes.definition: Student-produced or student-linked work, observations, scores, images, audio, text, or derived evidence used to support a teaching decision.
classes.collection: Optional, purpose-specific, explicit teacher consent; warn teacher to remove names and identifiers before upload.
classes.storage: Separated raw-object storage and versioned approved summaries; no raw evidence in analytics or Git.
classes.default_retention: Raw evidence: 7 days Free, 30 days Pro, 90 days Premium; approved summary follows class retention unless teacher chooses shorter.
classes.deletion: Raw blob, OCR, thumbnails, and caches immediately; delete summary on request and invalidate dependent unapproved decisions.
classes.logging: Never log content, file names, OCR text, student identifiers, signed URLs, or model prompt/response; use random IDs and bounded counts.
classes.backup: Raw evidence excluded from general database/code backups; dedicated encrypted storage obeys the same short retention. Approved summaries expire with class backups within 30 days.
classes.provider: Send only after consent and redaction warning, under no-training/zero-retention terms where supported; evidence is delimited as untrusted data and never used as instructions.
classes.access: Owning teacher; time-bound processing worker; no routine support access.
classes.encryption: TLS in transit; per-environment encrypted storage; signed URLs are short-lived and never logged.

classes.definition: Credentials or values that grant authority or access.
classes.collection: Provision only through the approved secret/configuration channel; never through chat or support forms.
classes.storage: Environment/secret manager only; callback tokens stored as cryptographic hashes where lookup is required.
classes.default_retention: Only while operationally required; rotate on role change, incident, exposure suspicion, or scheduled policy.
classes.deletion: Revoke first, rotate dependants, then purge old values and invalidate sessions/tokens.
classes.logging: Prohibited. Redact matching names, authorization headers, query values, and provider payloads.
classes.backup: Excluded from code and database backups; secret-manager recovery follows provider controls.
classes.provider: Never sent to an LLM or analytics provider. Transmit only to the service that authenticates the credential over TLS.
classes.access: Runtime identity and minimum designated owner/operator only.
classes.encryption: Secret-manager encryption and TLS; never plaintext in repository, artifacts, or tickets.

provider_requirements.required: Document the exact operation and fields before enabling a provider.
Contractual/API no-training setting for teacher account, class context, and student evidence.
Prefer zero retention; otherwise document provider duration and keep it within the disclosed TeacherOS duration.
Record regions and subprocessors before pilot; material changes require review.
TLS, access control, incident notification, deletion support, and independently reviewed security posture.
System instructions precede a clearly delimited UNTRUSTED_EVIDENCE block; tool execution is disabled for evidence analysis.
Store request ID, model identifier, latency, token counts, and bounded status only; never store content.
Timeout/refusal/unsafe output returns a recoverable teacher-controlled state and no final diagnosis.

backup_restore_rules: Backups are encrypted, inventory-tagged, access-audited, and restore-tested with synthetic data.
Raw student evidence is not included in general SQLite or code backups.
Deletion tombstones are stored separately and replayed before a restored backup becomes reachable.
No backup containing teacher account or class context remains recoverable beyond 30 days after replacement.
A restored environment starts with external messaging, billing, and LLM calls disabled until ownership and deletion reconciliation passes.
